## When to use
Check remote vault health — orphan notes, dangling links, graph density, methodology grounding, MOC coverage, processing stats. Saves results to the bai/health-report document. All checks run against the live reactor via Switchboard CLI.

## What it covers
- Pre-flight
- Step 1: Gather metrics from the subgraph
- Step 2: Gather everything from the graph in one request
- Step 3: Check methodology grounding via note content
- Step 4: Check MOC coverage and the hierarchy
- Step 5: Compute diagnostic checks
- Step 6: Save to bai/health-report document
- Step 7: Auto-repair (if `--fix` or user requests)
- Step 8: Report to user
- Stranded sources
- What belongs in `recommendations`
- Scope methodology grounding honestly
- Re-run after every fix
- Reading health history

## Where the full skill lives
- Vault source: **Agent skill: health** (full SKILL.md text, DERIVED_FROM below)
- Canonical copy: plugin repo `skills/health/SKILL.md` — always execute from the repo copy; this note is the discovery layer.

## Invocation
`/powerhouse-knowledge:health` in Claude Code (plugin installed), or read the source content and follow it manually.
